# Eight Miles West

> A family's four centuries in America, from New Amsterdam to the Pacific: the Croesen / Kroesen / Krewson line, read from the documents, one chapter at a time.

Published as numbered chapters meant to be read in order; each chapter cites the records (church registers, wills, censuses, newspapers) it is built from.

Part of the m8k.io family of publications by "Mr. Librarian" (index: https://m8k.io/llms.txt).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://west.m8k.io/): the chapters in order
- [About](https://west.m8k.io/about.html): the project and its sources
